title: Comparator invariant after scanned columns
statement: Let $w_0,w_1,w_2,w_3$ be finite little-endian binary words and let $j$ be a natural number. After $j$ columns have been scanned, the comparator invariant on the control registers and the words with their first $j$ bits dropped holds if and only if $\operatorname{val}(w_0)+\operatorname{val}(w_1)=\operatorname{val}(w_2)+\operatorname{val}(w_3)$, where $\operatorname{val}$ denotes the little-endian binary value.
replaced: For every four words and every column count $j$, the comparator invariant at the control after $j$ columns, applied to the words with their first $j$ bits dropped, holds exactly when the value of the first word plus the second equals the value of the third plus the fourth; columns beyond a short word read zeros, never uncharged random access.
